name: duit-loan-match
description: Match Indian borrowers to eligible RBI-regulated lenders using coarse eligibility ranges only — zero PII shared before the user applies.

interface.longDescription:
Matches Indian borrowers to the right RBI-regulated lender using only coarse ranges — zero PII, no CIBIL impact, before any application is made.

Duit Loan Match helps match an Indian borrower to the lender most likely to approve them — before they ever apply.

Instead of blasting an application to every lender (which hits the borrower's credit bureau and lowers approval odds), this tool takes a borrower profile in coarse, non-identifying ranges — profession type, loan amount band, income band, CIBIL score band, age band, pincode, and repayment history — and returns a shortlist of eligible lenders from Duit's panel of RBI-regulated banks and NBFCs.

What makes it different:
• Zero PII by design. The tool never asks for a name, phone number, email, or exact address — only a 6-digit pincode and coarse ranges. Nothing identifying is stored.
• Pre-application matching. Borrowers see their eligible lenders before any formal application touches their credit bureau, so checking doesn't cost them anything.
• Real eligibility logic, not a guess. Matches are computed by Duit's live underwriting rules engine against each lender's actual, current criteria — not a static list.
• Transparent disclosures. Every match includes the lender's regulated entity type, APR range, tenure, fees, and RBI grievance contact, plus a clear disclosure that Duit is a referral partner and this is an eligibility match, not an approval guarantee.

Duit Digital Private Limited is a Mumbai-based Lending Service Provider (LSP) under RBI digital lending guidelines, founded by credit-risk professionals with a combined 18+ years across HDFC Bank, HSBC, CitiFinancial, and Fullerton India. Duit does not lend — RBI-regulated partner banks and NBFCs approve and disburse loans. Duit is part of the Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub and the NVIDIA Inception program.
defaultPrompt: Find loan options for me based on my income and credit profile
What personal loans am I eligible for in India?
Compare lenders for a ₹2 lakh personal loan

positive.description: Salaried borrower with a strong profile, small loan
positive.prompt: I'm a salaried bank employee earning ₹40,000 a month, CIBIL score 720, I'm 28, need a ₹1.5 lakh loan, my pincode is 400001, and I've never missed a payment.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 3 or more eligible lenders (e.g. DMI Finance, Hero FinCorp) each with APR range, tenure, fees, and the referral/eligibility disclosure.

positive.prompt: I run a small shop, earn about ₹30,000 a month in cash, I've never had a loan or credit card before, I'm 35 and need ₹75,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a narrower list of lenders that accept thin-file / new-to-credit profiles, or an honest 'no eligible match' message — never a fabricated approval.

positive.description: Salaried borrower with a past missed payment
positive.prompt: I'm salaried, earn ₹60,000 a month, I've missed a couple of payments before, I'm 45 and need a ₹3 lakh loan.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns fewer, tighter matches reflecting the overdue history, each still carrying full lender disclosures.

positive.description: Borrower who also qualifies for secured or alternate products
positive.prompt: Salaried, ₹75,000 a month, CIBIL 750+, I'm 35, need a ₹5 lakh loan, pincode 400061, no missed payments.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns personal-loan lenders plus any secured or alternate-product matches (e.g. loan against mutual funds, two-wheeler loan) clearly labeled as a different product, not a personal-loan match.

positive.description: Skilled worker with established credit history
positive.prompt: I'm a skilled tradesperson earning ₹55,000 a month, I already have 2 to 3 credit cards or loans, all paid on time, CIBIL 740, I'm 38 and need ₹2 lakh.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the widest match list, since the optional credit-history field unlocks additional lenders per the tool's schema.

negative.description: Asks the assistant to submit the loan application directly
negative.prompt: Just go ahead and submit a loan application for me with DMI Finance right now.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool is never used to submit anything — it only returns eligibility matches and a referral link. The assistant explains that applying happens on the lender's own page, not inside ChatGPT.

negative.description: Tries to supply identifying personal information
negative.prompt: My name is Rohan Mehta, phone number 98765xxxxx, here's my Aadhaar number — find me a loan.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool's input schema has no field for name, phone, or Aadhaar. The assistant proceeds only with the coarse eligibility ranges the tool actually accepts, and never echoes or stores the identifying details.

negative.prompt: Can you help me write my resume?
negative.expected_behavior: find_loan_options is not called at all — this request has nothing to do with loan matching.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It only returns lender eligibility matches and a referral link; any application or payment happens on the lender's own page, outside ChatGPT.
